scope: Frame E census: 60 figure-scoped section chunks x 3 arms x (1 generation + 2 judges) = 540 calls. Generator qwen/qwen3-vl-8b-instruct on OpenRouter; judges claude-opus-5 and gpt-5.6-sol on omniproxy, both unchanged from the frame-D census. Zero retry, no fallback, no replacement.
why_this_run: The frame-D census returned no separable admission contrast (0.64 / 0.61 / 0.54, p=0.845 and p=0.248). Dataset criterion C5 measured the cause: the section evidence span has median 7530 and maximum 265885 characters, and a verbatim gate over a span that long is nearly free to satisfy. Frame E scopes the span to the figure's own pages (median 1571, max 7634) while keeping the section as the unit of analysis, and tests whether the gate discriminates again.
